_comment: Serving tuples out of the score and watch rotation. Their transcripts and scores stay under runs/, and the public page and leaderboard.json show each one as parked with its reason. To re-activate a tuple, move it back into configs/continuous.json and configs/watch.json and drop parked_on/parked_reason. A model that a provider replaces is a new tuple with its own label, never a continuation of the old one.

targets.label: OpenAI via OpenRouter
targets.parked_reason: OpenAI's endpoint for this model on OpenRouter is not zero-data-retention (ZDR), and the index account only routes to ZDR endpoints. Every request since the tuple was added on 2 Sep 2026 has failed with HTTP 404; never scored.

targets.label: SambaNova via OpenRouter
targets.parked_reason: OpenRouter no longer routes the 'sambanova' slug for this model; SambaNova serves it only as the 'sambanova-turbo' endpoint, measured as a separate tuple (SambaNova Turbo via OpenRouter). Never scored under this pin.

targets.label: Together via OpenRouter
targets.parked_reason: Together no longer serves this model on OpenRouter (last served 17 Oct 2026; pinned requests fail with HTTP 404 since 25 Oct 2026). Earlier scores are history.

targets.label: Crusoe via OpenRouter
targets.parked_reason: Crusoe no longer serves this model on OpenRouter (last served 13 Sep 2026; pinned requests fail with HTTP 404 since 16 Sep 2026). Earlier scores are history.

targets.label: EigenAI (EigenCloud, bit-exact claim)

targets.parked_reason: OpenRouter serves this free model only to listed agentic apps (HTTP 403 for any other caller), and its endpoint is not zero-data-retention. Never scored.

targets.parked_reason: AtlasCloud no longer serves this model on OpenRouter, and none of its OpenRouter endpoints is zero-data-retention. Never scored.
